subsystems.name: Photon transmitter
subsystems.role: encodes each key bit into the quantum state of a very faint light pulse.

subsystems.name: Quantum channel
subsystems.role: carries single photons between the two parties, where any eavesdropping disturbs them.

subsystems.name: Single-photon detectors
subsystems.role: register individual photons at the receiver.
parts: avalanche photodiodes or superconducting nanowire detectors

subsystems.name: Classical channel
subsystems.role: public link used to compare measurement bases and correct errors, and it must be authenticated.

subsystems.name: Post-processing
subsystems.role: turns raw correlated detections into a short, provably secret key.

subsystems.name: Trusted nodes
subsystems.role: extend reach beyond the range of a single link by decrypting and re-encrypting keys at secure intermediate sites.

subsystems.name: Encryption integration
subsystems.role: feeds the fresh key to equipment that actually protects the data.

buildSteps.title: Choose protocol and encoding
buildSteps.detail: Pick a scheme such as BB84 and decide whether bits are encoded in photon polarization or phase, matching it to the link.

buildSteps.title: Build the transmitter
buildSteps.detail: Assemble laser, attenuator, random number generator and modulator so that pulses contain on average less than one photon.

buildSteps.title: Build the receiver
buildSteps.detail: Install single-photon detectors, cooling if needed, and optics that preserve the chosen encoding.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the link
buildSteps.detail: Align polarization or phase drift, measure the quantum bit error rate and set a threshold above which the key is discarded.

buildSteps.title: Deploy the channel
buildSteps.detail: Use dark fibre between sites, or a free-space telescope path, inserting trusted nodes where the distance is too great.

buildSteps.title: Run the key exchange
buildSteps.detail: Detectors record clicks, the parties compare bases over the authenticated classical channel, then sift to shared bits.

buildSteps.title: Distil a secret key
buildSteps.detail: Error correction reconciles mismatches; privacy amplification compresses the result so an eavesdropper's partial knowledge is useless.

buildSteps.title: Integrate and certify
buildSteps.detail: Feed the key to encryptors, test against the operator and standards requirements, then monitor continuously for anomalies.

prerequisites.why: the receiver must catch individual photons without adding noise.

prerequisites.tech: Low-loss optical fibre and dark-fibre access
prerequisites.why: photons cannot be amplified, so loss directly limits range.
